[{"insert":"Barbell Preacher Curl + Cable Tricep Pushdown

Two arm isolation movements are paired together to finish the session with a bicep and tricep pump. The preacher curl locks the upper arm against the pad, removing any swing and placing the entire load on the biceps during the bottom stretch. The cable tricep pushdown keeps constant tension through the full range. Push close to failure on each set with minimal rest between movements.
"}]
